prompt: Which features control which clients can reach a Redis Cloud database at the network layer? Select all that apply.
explanation: The CIDR allow list filters source IP ranges, VPC peering moves the database onto a private network path that only connected VPCs can use, and blocking the public endpoint on a Pro subscription rejects any connection originating outside RFC 1918 private address space. The Default user password authenticates commands once a connection exists but does not gate network reachability, and TLS encrypts the connection without deciding who may connect.

options.text: VPC peering between the application VPC and the Redis Cloud VPC
Blocking the public endpoint on a Pro subscription
Setting a new Default user password
Enabling TLS with the Redis Cloud certificate authority bundle
